questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A person who walks in his sleep'
questions.explanation:
Somnambulist = one who walks while asleep.
Insomniac = one who cannot sleep. Narcissist = excessively self-admiring.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'An extreme or irrational fear of heights'
questions.explanation:
Acrophobia = fear of heights.
Claustrophobia = fear of enclosed spaces; Hydrophobia = fear of water; Agoraphobia = fear of open/public spaces.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The act of killing one's own father'
questions.explanation:
Patricide = killing of one's father.
Matricide = mother; Fratricide = brother; Infanticide = infant.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The scientific study of birds'
questions.explanation:
Ornithology = study of birds.
Entomology = insects; Geology = rocks/earth; Botany = plants.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A person who can speak only two languages'
questions.explanation:
Bilingual = fluent in exactly two languages.
Monolingual = one language; Multilingual = several languages; Polyglot = many languages.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'One who has a great love of books'
questions.explanation:
Bibliophile = a person who loves and collects books.
Philanthropist = loves humanity; Heliophile = loves the sun; Xenophile = loves foreigners/things.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A doctor who specialises in the treatment of mental illness'
questions.explanation:
Psychiatrist = a medical doctor specialising in mental disorders.
Pediatrician = children; Cardiologist = heart; Dermatologist = skin.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The act of killing a king'
questions.explanation:
Regicide = the killing of a king.
Homicide = a human being; Infanticide = an infant; Fratricide = a brother.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'An extreme fear of open or public places'
questions.explanation:
Agoraphobia = fear of open or public places.
Acrophobia = heights; Claustrophobia = enclosed spaces; Hydrophobia = water.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A system of government in which the people elect their rulers'
questions.explanation:
Democracy = government by the people through elected representatives.
Monarchy = king/queen; Aristocracy = nobles; Oligarchy = small group.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'One who has a deep hatred of all humans'
questions.explanation:
Misanthrope = a person who hates or distrusts humankind.
Philanthropist = loves humanity; Humanist = values human welfare; Altruist = selflessly helps others.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A person who displays excessive patriotism and advocates an aggressive foreign policy'
questions.explanation:
Jingoist = a person who advocates extreme, aggressive patriotism.
Patriot = loves one's country (positive); Nationalist = promotes national interests; Anarchist = opposes all government.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A place where bees are kept'
questions.explanation:
Apiary = a place where bees are kept.
Aviary = large cage for birds; Granary = grain storage; Sanctuary = protected natural area.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'Government by the very wealthy'
questions.explanation:
Plutocracy = a government or state governed by the wealthy.
Democracy = the people; Theocracy = God/priests; Bureaucracy = officials.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'An extreme or irrational fear of water'
questions.explanation:
Hydrophobia = fear of water.
Aquaphilia = love of water; Claustrophobia = enclosed spaces; Acrophobia = heights.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The study of ancient handwriting and documents'
questions.explanation:
Palaeography = the study of ancient and historical handwriting.
Cartography = maps; Calligraphy = art of beautiful handwriting; Lithography = printing technique.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'One who does not believe in the existence of God'
questions.explanation:
Atheist = a person who does not believe in God.
Agnostic = unsure about God's existence; Theist = believes in God; Deist = believes in a creator God without revelation.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A large enclosure for keeping birds in confinement'
questions.explanation:
Aviary = a large cage or enclosure for keeping birds.
Granary = grain storage; Apiary = bees; Repository = storage place for items.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The branch of knowledge dealing with coins, medals, and currency'
questions.explanation:
Numismatics = the study or collection of coins, banknotes, and medals.
Philately = stamps; Ceramics = pottery; Heraldry = coats of arms.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The act of killing one's own brother'
questions.explanation:
Fratricide = the killing of one's brother.
Matricide = mother; Patricide = father; Regicide = king.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'One who knows everything'
questions.explanation:
Omniscient = having total knowledge; knowing everything.
Omnipotent = all-powerful; Omnivore = eats both plants and animals; Omnipresent = present everywhere.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A person who can endure pain or hardship without complaint'
questions.explanation:
Stoic = a person who endures pain or difficulty without complaint.
Epicure = devoted to sensory pleasure (especially food); Hedonist = devoted to pleasure; Cynic = questions people's motives.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'An extreme fear of confined or enclosed spaces'
questions.explanation:
Claustrophobia = fear of enclosed or confined spaces.
Agoraphobia = open/public spaces; Acrophobia = heights; Hydrophobia = water.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'A person who is fluent in many languages'
questions.explanation:
Polyglot = a person who knows and is able to use several languages.
Bilingual = two languages; Monolingual = one language; Multilingual = many (but Polyglot specifically implies fluency and proficiency).
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: 'The study of the origin and history of words'
questions.explanation:
Etymology = the study of the origin and historical development of words.
Entomology = insects; Ethology = animal behaviour; Epistemology = nature of knowledge.
questions.subject: English
